payload.reason: The evidence clearly identifies KAR as an end-to-end Machine Reading Comprehension (MRC) model that integrates general knowledge to enhance its performance.

claims.text: KAR is an end-to-end Machine Reading Comprehension (MRC) model.
KAR explicitly uses extracted general knowledge to assist its attention mechanisms.
KAR is designed to be robust to noise and requires less data compared to state-of-the-art MRC models.
